home.made.sofar: So far, nothing we have shipped has asked you for an account, and nothing we have shipped reports what you do with it.
home.how.p1: The internet has become heavier and more demanding than it needs to be, and most of us now carry a collection of software that quietly works against the person using it. We would like the small part of it we are responsible for to feel calm, and to be safe in the plain sense of that word, meaning that it holds nothing over you and keeps nothing you did not offer.
home.how.p2: We are drawn to the quiet middle of things, the place where capable software meets someone who should not have to study it first. We would happily spend a long season making one narrow thing genuinely good, and we measure a release by how little it ends up asking of you.
home.how.pr1_t: We build on work that already holds up
home.how.pr1_b: Someone has usually spent years solving the difficult part properly, and that work deserves to be built upon. We go looking for what is still missing around it, which is almost always the part a person actually touches.
home.how.pr2_t: We keep things close to home
home.how.pr2_b: Your own machine is where we start, and anything living elsewhere has to earn its place by making the experience meaningfully better for you. There is a quiet reassurance in knowing that when nothing sits in the middle, very little can be taken away from you later.
home.how.pr3_t: We treat finishing as part of the job
home.how.pr3_b: Getting something out of the door is the easy half. What settles whether it is genuinely done tends to be less visible, like the installer that behaves properly on a machine we have never seen, or the release note that tells you what actually changed in language you would use yourself.
home.how.pr4_t: We test against the real thing
home.how.pr4_b: We are wary of tests that only confirm what we already believed. Ours run the real software under real conditions, doing the things you would plausibly do with it, because the bugs worth catching have a habit of sailing past the easy checks first.
home.how.pr5_t: We take things out as carefully as we put them in
home.how.pr5_b: Software grows heavier by accumulation, and a good deal of our attention goes to the option we chose to leave alone and the screen we removed once it had stopped carrying its weight.
home.room.intro: We would rather be clear now about the decisions we take one at a time, so that nothing we do later arrives as a surprise.
home.room.link_aria: Copy a link to this decision
home.room.price_b: Costing nothing is where our work has started. We weigh that individually for each piece of work, and when something is worth paying for we will say so plainly and price it honestly.
home.room.openness_b: We publish the parts where reading the source is what earns your trust, and we keep others closed. It is a judgement we make each time, and we are happy to give our reasons. The licences on the work above say which side each piece landed on.
home.room.openness_s: so far: one open, one partly open
home.room.accounts_b: We ask for as little as a piece of work allows, which so far has meant asking for nothing at all. If we build something that genuinely has to know who you are, signing in will be the smallest part of using it, and we will hold on to nothing the feature can do without.
home.room.services_b: Our work has had no need for one so far. Should we build something that genuinely calls for a service behind it, we will build it carefully and tell you exactly what it holds and how long it holds it.
home.room.scope_b: What we have made so far describes where we have been. We expect our interests to move, and we would like the freedom to follow them.
home.floor.intro: The section above is where we have deliberately left ourselves room. A page that left itself room everywhere would be worth very little, so here is the floor underneath it. These four do not move, whatever we go on to build.
home.floor.link_aria: Copy a link to this commitment
home.floor.f1_b: Whatever you put into something we make stays readable and portable by you, and we will not sell it or turn it into a profile of you.
home.floor.f2_b: We will not place advertising inside our work, and we will not take money to put somebody else's interest ahead of yours.
home.floor.f3_t: Leaving is as easy as arriving
home.floor.f3_b: Your things come out in a form you can actually use, and we would count it as our own failure if the thing keeping you were the awkwardness of going.
home.floor.f4_t: It keeps working if we stop
home.floor.f4_b: We have no plans to disappear, though it would be careless to write as though nobody ever does. Anything we retire keeps working on the machines it already sits on for as long as we can manage, and you will hear it from us well before you notice it yourself.
home.talk.p1: There is a person at the other end of the address below, and the messages get read. If something we made is behaving badly, or you would like to know why we settled a decision the way we did, write and ask. We would far sooner answer that than have you guess.
home.talk.p2: The floor above is written to be checked against what we ship: start with each product's privacy page and published source, and write to us when anything does not match.
